title: test_channel_plan.py: test_ccp16_vectors never calls select_channel()
description: Lines 225-238: The test claims to 'Verify select_channel' (line 225 comment) against test vectors, but it never actually calls the select_channel() function (imported at line 27). Instead, it computes expected_ch locally using the formula at line 230, gets actual_ch from the test vector file (lines 232-234), and compares them. This validates internal consistency of the test vector file and the local formula, but does NOT test the select_channel() implementation. A bug in select_channel() would go undetected by this test.
close_reason: The test_ccp16_vectors function now calls select_channel() at lines 332 and 335. The bead references outdated line numbers (225-238 vs current 275-337), indicating the file was modified since the issue was filed and the bug has been fixed.
